title: Central Authority may impose penalty
description: impose penalty on manufacturer or endorser for false or misleading advertisement

conditions: it is necessary to impose a penalty
false or misleading advertisement by a manufacturer or an endorser
person found to publish or is a party to the publication of a misleading advertisement
limitations: penalty may extend to ten lakh rupees for first contravention
penalty may extend to fifty lakh rupees for subsequent contraventions
